purpose: prospective test of locally trained clock/candidate preparation model
order: rotate all three groups at each rate and cycle
primary_metric: common-prefix transactions per second at exact 2s and 12s observation boundaries, only if both hashes and counts match final shared canonical chain
missing: retain all failed/missing proofs; no success imputation
claims: Three repeats are exploratory; no finality or long-term sustainable capacity claim. P75 preparation lead is not a safety bound. New runs never enter this frozen model training. Report all rates and repetitions.
faults: no injected faults in this throughput phase
restore: restore previous Chain and FISCO services after experiment
cleanup: stop and verify identity before deleting each isolated experimental database; retain logs and source
